cases.mapping: A new marginal ECDF: blue Before and orange After; stepped lines run from fraction 0 to 1 on the adopted four-decade logarithmic IgG axis. This is not a reproduction of an ECDF in the paper.
cases.visual_evidence: The two marginal step curves remain distinct in the 397×322 proxy. Current legend keys are independently measured as 6.000 mm with 0.9 pt strokes and the same blue/orange colors as the plotted curves. The guide now uses about one third of data-region width, remains a shallow single row, and leaves the curves visually primary. The current separate caption explicitly states one participant at one time point as the observation unit and describes the dataset-specific jump rule; those numerical claims were not audited here.

findings.evidence: The color meaning is time point, while the paper reference uses color for prior-infection cohorts; the supplied caption discloses this new marginal view and the loss of individual pairing. No extra panel prose or title is present.
findings.requirement: A new create view must be explicit about its mapping and keep explanatory prose in the caption.
findings.action: Keep the supplied separate caption with this panel.
